description:
## Features

### YouTube
- **Visual preferences icons:** New icon style `YouTube`. RVX settings rows use YouTube's own rounded settings icons, the same family the app's own Settings screen draws, wherever one fits the setting (679 of 835 rows on 21.39.525). The other rows keep the RVX icon, drawn with rounded line ends at the same weight so they blend in. Rows use the stock spacing, and the toolbar arrow and search icon are bold. Pick it in the patch options (`Icon style`), with `Apply to all settings menu` on for the sub-settings.
  - YouTube 21.13.164 has fewer of these icons, so 653 rows use them.
  - YouTube 20.05.46 does not have this icon family, so every row uses the rounded RVX icons.
  - `Regular`, `Bold`, `Bold (stock size)` and YouTube Music are unchanged.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.23.0...v1.24.0)
